finalMessage:
`tax` is now `salesTax` in the new `src/salestax.ts`, and everything still works. All 36 tests pass, and `ostf check --base main` reports no errors (40 items, 111 valid links).

- **Code:** `roundHalfUp` was only used by `tax`, so it moved with it. `price` in `src/pricing.ts` now imports and calls `salesTax`. I renamed its local variable to `taxDue` so it doesn't clash with the import.
- **Tests:** the two `tax` tests moved to a new `src/salestax.test.ts` under `describe("salesTax")`, including the `@req R-TAX-EXEMPT` tag.
- **Trace:** in `trace/requirements.yaml`, I repointed the `code` and `tests` links of R-TAX-RATE and R-TAX-EXEMPT to the new locations. I didn't touch any item text.
- **README:** added a `src/salestax.ts` row and trimmed the `pricing.ts` description.

`ostf check` reports these links as added (new locations):
- `src/salestax.ts#salesTax implements R-TAX-EXEMPT`
- `src/salestax.ts#salesTax implements R-TAX-RATE`
- `src/salestax.test.ts#salesTax > is zero for a tax-exempt customer verifies R-TAX-EXEMPT`
- `src/salestax.test.ts#salesTax > rounds half up to the cent verifies R-TAX-RATE`

It reports these links as removed (old locations):
- `src/pricing.ts#tax implements R-TAX-EXEMPT`
- `src/pricing.ts#tax implements R-TAX-RATE`
- `src/pricing.test.ts#tax > is zero for a tax-exempt customer verifies R-TAX-EXEMPT`
- `src/pricing.test.ts#tax > rounds half up to the cent verifies R-TAX-RATE`

I stamped those four added links, plus `src/pricing.ts#price implements R-TAX-RATE`, which `ostf check` had flagged as suspect because its body changed. I stamped them after rechecking the code against the items and getting a passing test run.

Neither R-TAX-RATE nor R-TAX-EXEMPT is risk-relevant, so I didn't need to ask first. No item became false.

I haven't committed anything.
